s: Which project had its Phase I inaugurated at Markapuram on 31 August 2026?
x: Phase I of the Poola Subbaiah Veligonda Project was inaugurated at Markapuram on 31 August 2026. Nallamala Sagar is the destination of the water, while Ramayapatnam Port and the Bengaluru–Amaravati Highway are linked plans.

s: With reference to Phase I of the Veligonda Project, which of the following statements is incorrect?
o: The destination of the water is the Srisailam Reservoir.
The project has an allocation of 10.70 TMC.
The source is the Krishna on the foreshore of the Srisailam Reservoir.
Water is conveyed by gravity through twin tunnels measuring 18.8 km.
x: The incorrect statement identifies the Srisailam Reservoir as the destination; the correct destination is Nallamala Sagar. The Srisailam Reservoir foreshore is the source, and the conveyance is by gravity through twin tunnels measuring 18.8 km.

s: What is the water allocation of Phase I of the Veligonda Project?
x: Phase I has 10.70 TMC and supplies drinking water to 4 lakh people; it irrigates 1.19 lakh acres.

s: Where was Krishna water released when Phase I of the Veligonda Project was inaugurated on 31 August 2026?
x: Krishna water was released at Ghantavanipalli in Dornala mandal, Markapuram district, not at Nallamala Sagar.

s: Near which place does the Krishna River rise?
x: The Krishna rises near Mahabaleshwar, not near the Srisailam Reservoir.

s: Which of the following correctly describes the Veligonda Project Phase I?
o: It diverts Krishna water from Polavaram to North Coastal Andhra through pumps.
It carries surplus Godavari floodwater to Rayalaseema through a single canal.
It carries Krishna water from Srisailam to Nallamala Sagar through twin tunnels.
It links the Pennar and Krishna rivers through the Banakacherla regulator.
x: Veligonda Phase I carries Krishna water from Srisailam into Nallamala Sagar through twin tunnels.

s: Which of the following districts are stated to benefit from the Veligonda Project?
x: The project benefits Markapuram, Prakasam, Nellore and Kadapa districts.

s: The 2026 Catch the Rain campaign referred to in the news was conducted in which district and during which period?
x: The campaign was conducted in Nandyal district from 4 July to 4 August 2026. The other options alter either the dates or the district.

s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Clean Godavari initiative?
o: The Centre assured support for the Mission Godavari Clean Project on the lines of Namami Gange
The Pushkaram theme is "Swachh Godavari, Pavitra Pushkaralu"
260 model panchayats along the Godavari were included under Viksit Bharat-Gram Gaurav
A CPCB team will assess Godavari pollution after the next Godavari Pushkarams
x: The CPCB assessment is to be done before, not after, the next Godavari Pushkarams.

s: Under which programme were 260 model panchayats along the Godavari included in Andhra Pradesh?
x: The 260 model panchayats along the Godavari were included under the Viksit Bharat–Gram Gaurav programme. Namami Gange was the model for the Mission Godavari Clean Project, while “Swachh Godavari, Pavitra Pushkaralu” was the Pushkaram theme.

s: Which project led Andhra Pradesh to move the Supreme Court in 2023 because of its impact on Anantapur, Kadapa and Kurnool?
x: Andhra Pradesh moved the Supreme Court in 2023 over the Upper Bhadra project in Karnataka, which affects Anantapur, Kadapa and Kurnool. The other options refer to different water, urban-development or semiconductor matters.

s: After Gate No. 19 was washed out in the 2024 monsoon, how many crest gates of the Tungabhadra dam were replaced?
x: All 33 crest gates, nearly 70 years old, were replaced after the 2024 washout of Gate No. 19.

s: The Tungabhadra River is formed by the confluence of which two rivers?
x: The Tungabhadra is formed by the Tunga and Bhadra rivers in the Western Ghats. Krishna and Godavari are not the two rivers that form the Tungabhadra.

s: Which body manages the Tungabhadra dam and project?
x: The Tungabhadra project is managed by the Tungabhadra Board; the KWDT deals with water allocation.

s: At which place does the Tungabhadra join the Krishna River?
x: The Tungabhadra joins the Krishna at Sangamaleshwaram in Andhra Pradesh. Hamsaladeevi is where the Krishna meets the sea, while Shivamogga and Hosapete are associated with the river system and dam region.

s: What is the total ayacut of the Veligonda Project?
x: Veligonda will irrigate 4.47 lakh acres in 30 mandals; Phase I covers 1.19 lakh acres.

s: Near which town is the Tungabhadra dam, whose 33 crest gates were replaced in 2026, located?
x: The Tungabhadra dam is near Hosapete in Vijayanagara district, Karnataka.

s: In which year was the foundation stone of the Veligonda Project laid?
x: The foundation stone was laid on 5 March 1996; Phase I was inaugurated on 31 August 2026.

s: Which of the following is NOT a tributary of the Krishna?
x: Bhima, Tungabhadra, Ghataprabha, Malaprabha and Musi are Krishna tributaries; Indravati joins the Godavari.

s: Near which place does the Krishna River meet the Bay of Bengal?
x: The Krishna meets the sea at Hamsaladeevi; the Tungabhadra joins it at Sangamaleshwaram.

s: Which of the following was included in the renewable-energy transmission works associated with the July 2026 Andhra Pradesh projects package?
o: High-level bridge at Lingasamudram under NH-565
x: Kurnool-IV REZ Phase-I was included among the renewable-energy transmission works. The other options are highway projects, not renewable-energy transmission works.

s: Which one of the following National Highway works was included among the projects for which foundation stones were laid on 1 August 2026?
x: The projects included a bridge at Lingasamudram on NH-565. The other alternatives relate to railway or industrial infrastructure, not that National Highway package.

s: Who inaugurated the Alluri Sitarama Raju International Airport at Bhogapuram?
x: Prime Minister Narendra Modi inaugurated the airport; GMR Visakhapatnam International Airport Ltd is its developer.

s: Which of the following pairs about the Bhogapuram airport is correctly matched?
o: Developer – GMR Visakhapatnam International Airport Ltd
Phase I capacity – 16 lakh passengers per year
x: GMR Visakhapatnam International Airport Ltd is the developer. The airport is at Bhogapuram, Vizianagaram district, costs over ₹5,640 crore and has a capacity of about 60 lakh (6 million) passengers per year.

s: Which dance performance at the Bhogapuram airport event set a Guinness World Records achievement?
x: The Thimsa performance, a tribal folk dance of North Andhra and Odisha, was associated with the Guinness World Records achievement.

s: Which of the following statements about Bhogapuram airport is incorrect?
o: The airport is being developed under the greenfield PPP model at a cost of more than ₹5,640 crore.
The airport includes a 10 MW solar plant and its design is inspired by Chuttilu cottages and Araku Valley.
The airport will use AI-enabled operations, biometric processing and an Airport Predictive Operations Centre.
Its planned capacity is about 6 million passengers per year.
x: The incorrect statement is the one mentioning a 10 MW solar plant. Bhogapuram airport is planned with a 5 MW solar plant; its greenfield PPP model, capacity of about 6 million passengers per year and technology features are correctly stated.

s: After being notified as an Immigration Check Post, Bhogapuram became which airport in the Category-1 list?
x: Bhogapuram became the 39th airport in the Category-1 list, notified under the Immigration and Foreigners Act.

s: Where did the Prime Minister launch projects worth ₹17,900 crore?
x: The Prime Minister launched projects worth ₹17,900 crore at Bhogapuram on 1 August 2026.

s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Alluri Sitarama Raju International Airport?
o: It replaced the civil enclave at INS Dega
It was described as the first greenfield airport since 2014
It was developed by the Airports Authority of India
x: The airport was developed by GMR through GVIAL, not by the Airports Authority of India.

s: Which one of the following is NOT correctly matched with the Alluri Sitarama Raju International Airport?
o: Initial capacity — 16 million passengers per annum
x: The airport's initial capacity is 6 million passengers per annum, not 16 million. Its location is Bhogapuram, its code is VTZ and its runway is 3,800 metres long.

s: Where is Andhra Pradesh’s first semiconductor packaging unit being established?
x: The unit is being established at Tarluvada in Anandapuram Mandal of Visakhapatnam district. Bhogapuram is the airport location, while Ghantavanipalli and Penchalakona–Yerrapadu refer to locations associated with other projects.

s: Which heliport received India's first private Point-in-Space (PinS) Instrument Approach Procedure approval?
x: Undavalli Heliport received the approval; the procedure was developed by AAI to ICAO standards.

s: GAGAN (GPS Aided GEO Augmented Navigation), used for the Undavalli Heliport's navigation procedure, was developed by which bodies?
x: GAGAN is a GPS Aided GEO Augmented Navigation system developed by ISRO and AAI.

s: The Recharla–Guravayigudem expressway inaugurated on 1 August 2026 lies on which National Highway?
x: The expressway is on the Khammam–Devarapalli NH-365BG; NH-67 has the Tadipatri bypass.

s: What is the capacity of the Kurnool-IV Renewable Energy Zone, whose transmission foundation was laid on 1 August 2026?
x: Kurnool-IV REZ is 4.5 GW; 2,500 MW and 1,000 MW are the Anantapur and Kurnool zones.

s: What is the runway length of the Alluri Sitarama Raju International Airport at Bhogapuram?
x: The airport has a 3,800 m runway and can withstand 275 kmph winds.

s: As which railway zone of India did South Coast Railway begin operations on 1 June 2026?
x: SCoR, headquartered at Visakhapatnam, became the 18th railway zone.

s: When did commercial flights begin at the Bhogapuram (Alluri Sitarama Raju) International Airport?
x: PM Modi dedicated the airport on 1 August 2026; commercial flights moved from Vizag on 17 August 2026.

s: Which body granted the Undavalli Heliport India's first private Point-in-Space (PinS) instrument approach approval?
x: The approval was granted by DGCA; the procedure was developed by AAI to ICAO standards.

s: A rail line to the port at the revived Kakinada SEZ is proposed from which station?
x: A rail line is proposed from Annavaram station to the port; the Bharatmala NH also passes through the KSEZ.

s: From which place to which place was the headquarters of the Andhra Pradesh Maritime Board shifted?
x: The headquarters of the Andhra Pradesh Maritime Board was shifted from Kakinada to Amaravati. The Directorate of Ports was also shifted to Amaravati, while the Board manages non-major ports.

s: What happened to the Kakinada Special Economic Zone, also known as Auro Industrial City, in July 2026?
o: It was revived after two decades
It was converted into the Kakinada Gateway Port
It became the APEX Korea overseas centre
It was inaugurated as Rayalaseema Steel Limited
x: The Kakinada Special Economic Zone, also called Auro Industrial City, was revived after two decades. The Kakinada Gateway Port, APEX Korea and Rayalaseema Steel Limited are separate developments.

s: What is the approximate investment in the MoUs of the revived Kakinada Special Economic Zone?
x: The MoUs total about ₹1.5 lakh crore with potential for 1.5 lakh direct and indirect jobs.

s: Under the Special Economic Zones Act, 2005, how is a Special Economic Zone characterised?
o: A duty-free enclave treated as outside the customs territory
A duty-free enclave treated as within the customs territory
A notified zone limited to about 10 industries
x: A Special Economic Zone is a duty-free enclave treated as outside the customs territory under the SEZ Act, 2005. The description of a zone treated as within the customs territory reverses this key characteristic.

s: Which body manages the non-major ports of Andhra Pradesh?
x: The AP Maritime Board (est. 2019), now shifted to Amaravati, manages non-major ports.

s: Which of the following is NOT correct about Orvakal Drone City?
o: A special committee was asked to act on industry demands within 6 months
It is expected to create about 5,000 direct and 25,000 indirect jobs
In Phase 1, 12 plots were identified and 8 allotted
India needs more than 6 lakh drones against about 40,000 available
x: The special committee was to act on industry demands within 3 months, not 6.

s: In which valley do the Chintalapudi and Recharla coal blocks, proposed for Underground Coal Gasification in Eluru district, lie?
x: The blocks hold about 3,130.61 MT of coal deeper than 600 m in the Godavari Valley; UCG converts coal in situ into syngas of H₂ and CO.

s: The Kosala Nagaram Industrial Park, planned by APIIC near the Tamil Nadu border, is in which district?
x: APIIC plans the Kosala Nagaram Industrial Park in Chittoor district near the Tamil Nadu border, with Sri City as its model.

s: India’s first integrated Underground Coal Gasification (UCG) complex has been proposed in which district of Andhra Pradesh?
x: The first integrated UCG complex is proposed in Eluru district; Tirupati district hosts the Dugarajapatnam shipbuilding cluster.

s: Which became India's first major private-sector gold mine to start commercial production since Independence?
x: Swarnagiri became the first major private-sector gold mine in India to start commercial production since Independence.

s: By what name did Chief Minister N. Chandrababu Naidu rename the Jonnagiri Gold Mine in Kurnool district?
x: The Jonnagiri Gold Mine, operated by Geomysore Services in Tuggali mandal, was renamed Swarnagiri Gold Mine.

s: For what is Orvakal Drone City in Kurnool district planned as a national hub?
o: Drone manufacturing, R&D, testing and training
x: Orvakal Drone City is planned as a national hub for drone manufacturing, research and development, testing and training.

s: The Orvakal Drone City project is being developed through a partnership between the Andhra Pradesh Government and which Union ministry?
o: Union Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways
x: The partners are the Andhra Pradesh Government and the Union Ministry of Civil Aviation. The Ministry of Coal, the Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways, and the Ministry of Mines are associated with other subjects in the facts.

s: Which of the following project–location pairs in Rayalaseema is correctly matched?
o: DRDO AMCA integration and flight-testing centre – Near Tirupati
x: JSW’s integrated steel plant is at Kadapa; the KIA plant is at Penukonda in Sri Sathya Sai district (earlier Anantapur), Royal Enfield near Tirupati and the DRDO AMCA centre at Puttaparthi.

s: Which of the following correctly describes the early industrial base of Rayalaseema?
x: Rayalaseema’s early industries included cotton ginning and textiles. The other options refer to sectors associated with later investment proposals and industrial developments, not its early industrial base.

s: The Bharat Forge defence energetics project in Rayalaseema is located at which place?
x: Bharat Forge’s defence energetics project is located at Madakasira. Kadapa, Sri City and Puttaparthi are associated with other projects or industrial developments.

s: From which project is water for the Kosala Nagaram Industrial Park to come, via a balancing reservoir?
x: Supply is planned from Galeru Nagari Sujala Sravanthi through a balancing reservoir, scheduled by December 2028.

s: Which of the following was listed along with Bengaluru, Pune, Surat and Varanasi among the other cities under the City Economic Region scheme?
x: Bhubaneswar–Puri–Cuttack was one of the other city regions listed under the scheme. The other combinations refer to districts, the semiconductor project location or places connected with the inscriptions.

s: Which of the following correctly describes Orvakal industrial development?
o: A CBIC node of 13,919.67 acres with a 2,621-acre space city
A VCIC node of 33,000 acres with a 600-acre food park
A steel hub of 8.2 MTPA with a 2,000-acre aerospace park
An HBIC node of 2,621 acres with a 600-acre Drone City
x: Orvakal is an HBIC node covering 2,621 acres and includes a 600-acre Drone City.

s: Which of the following is NOT included among the industrial developments associated with Rayalaseema?
o: AM/NS India plant at Rajayyapeta near Anakapalli
x: Kia, Royal Enfield and Orvakal Drone City are listed among Rayalaseema’s industrial developments. The AM/NS India plant at Rajayyapeta is near Anakapalli, outside that list.

s: Where is the AMCA facility located in the Rayalaseema industrial hub?
x: The AMCA facility is at Puttaparthi. Orvakal has the Drone City, Kopparthy is the mega industrial hub becoming an electronics cluster, and a Space City is proposed near Sriharikota.

s: The Centre granted in-principle approval to which proposed project at Dugarajapatnam in Tirupati district?
x: The Centre granted in-principle approval to the Dugarajapatnam greenfield shipbuilding cluster. The Underground Coal Gasification complex is proposed in Eluru district, while the lithium and gallium initiative is an exploration pact.

s: What investment was proposed for the Rayalaseema horticulture hub in Andhra Pradesh?
x: The proposed investment for the Rayalaseema horticulture hub is ₹1 lakh crore. The other amounts do not represent this horticulture-hub proposal.

s: How much does each selected city receive under the City Economic Region scheme?
x: Each city receives ₹5,000 crore: ₹3,500 crore from the Centre and ₹1,500 crore in State loans.

s: Which of the following BHAVYA parks is NOT correctly matched with its location?
x: Veldurthi textiles is associated with Palnadu, not Prakasam. Space City, Drone City and the Makavaripalem food park are correctly matched.

s: What is the proposed investment for Reliance's Underground Coal Gasification complex in Eluru district?
x: Reliance's UCG complex is about ₹2.73 lakh crore over 30 years in 3 phases.

s: What is the Phase I capacity of JSW Rayalaseema Steel at Kadapa?
x: Phase I is 1 MTPA, expanded to 2 MTPA in Phase II.

s: Which is Andhra Pradesh's first semiconductor unit?
x: ASIP-APACT, a Korean-linked unit at Visakhapatnam, is identified as the first semiconductor unit.

s: Which one of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: First private-sector primary gold mine — Kakinada
Autonomous maritime shipbuilding centre — Tirupati district
First private-sector primary gold mine — Jonnagiri, Kurnool
x: Geomysore Services is associated with the first private-sector primary gold mine at Jonnagiri in Kurnool district.

s: Which JSW project in Rayalaseema was inaugurated by Chief Minister Naidu on July 3, 2026?
o: HFCL high-precision ammunition unit, Sri Sathya Sai district
x: JSW Rayalaseema Steel Limited at Kadapa was inaugurated by Chief Minister Naidu on July 3, 2026. The other options refer to separate automobile, space and defence projects in Rayalaseema.

s: Where is the electronics mega cluster of Rayalaseema located?
x: The electronics cluster (mega hub) is at Kopparthy; Orvakal has the Drone City.

s: Where is the KIA Motors car plant in Andhra Pradesh located?
x: The KIA plant is at Penukonda in Sri Sathya Sai district (earlier Anantapur).

s: Which company operates the Swarnagiri (Jonnagiri) Gold Mine in Kurnool district?
x: Geomysore Services runs the mine, the first major private gold mine in commercial production since Independence.

s: In which basin are lithium and gallium being explored under the AP–CSIR-NGRI pact of August 2026?
x: The pact covers lithium and gallium near Tummalapalle in the Cuddapah Basin, funded by the NMET.

s: Which body is the State nodal agency for BHAVYA industrial parks in Andhra Pradesh?
x: APIIC (est. 1973, Mangalagiri) is the State nodal agency for BHAVYA.

s: In which district is the Tekulodu Aerospace and Defence park under BHAVYA?
x: Tekulodu Aerospace & Defence park is in Sri Sathya Sai district.

s: Which city of Andhra Pradesh was selected under the City Economic Region (CER) scheme?
x: Visakhapatnam was selected; each city gets ₹5,000 crore (₹3,500 crore Centre + ₹1,500 crore State).

s: Underground coal gasification, proposed by Reliance in Eluru district, converts coal into which gas?
x: UCG turns coal into syngas, mainly hydrogen (H₂) and carbon monoxide (CO).

s: Which body fully funds the lithium and gallium exploration in the Cuddapah Basin under the AP–CSIR-NGRI pact?
x: The ₹140 crore work is 100% funded by the National Mineral Exploration Trust (est. 2015).

s: Where was the first Google AI Lab in Andhra Pradesh established?
x: The lab is at Vignan's University, Vadlamudi (Guntur district), set up with Gemini Enterprise for Education.

s: At what approximate cost is Andhra Pradesh's first semiconductor packaging unit, by ASIP Technologies with APACT Co., being set up?
x: The unit costs about ₹2,387 crore, not ₹4,750 crore; it is the first OSAT centre in South India under the ISM.

s: India’s first dedicated Quantum and AI University campus, approved on 27 August 2026, is being established at which place?
x: The first dedicated Quantum and AI University campus in India was approved for Amaravati. Guntur is associated with the interim classes at Acharya Nagarjuna University, while Vijayawada and Kadapa are not the campus location in this context.

s: From which body does the Quantum–AI University campus at Amaravati (₹730.70 crore over 5 years) get 100% Grant-in-Aid?
x: The campus is funded through 100% Grant-in-Aid from MeitY and will offer quantum computing, AI, VLSI and semiconductor fabrication courses.

s: The ASIP Semiconductor Project in Visakhapatnam is which semiconductor unit of Andhra Pradesh approved under the India Semiconductor Mission?
x: The ASIP project is Andhra Pradesh’s first semiconductor unit approved under the India Semiconductor Mission.

s: Where is Andhra Pradesh's first Quantum Incubator being established?
x: Chandigarh University is setting up AP’s first Quantum Incubator at Medha Towers, Gannavaram.

s: With the Google Cloud India AI Hub, Visakhapatnam could become which major gateway on India's eastern seaboard?
x: Visakhapatnam, on the eastern coast, could become India’s second major gateway on the eastern seaboard.

s: What is the stated focus of the first Google AI Lab in Andhra Pradesh at Vignan's University?
o: Hands-on Generative AI and Agentic AI
Investment-grade energy audits and water audits
High-performance computing and international subsea connectivity
x: The lab focuses on hands-on Generative AI and Agentic AI. The other options refer to EESL activities or features associated with the Google Cloud India AI Hub rather than the academic lab's stated focus.

s: In which year was the India Semiconductor Mission launched?
x: The India Semiconductor Mission was launched in 2021; Andhra Pradesh's Semiconductor and Display Fab Policy covers 2024–2029.

s: After which places is Andhra Pradesh expected to become India's third subsea gateway?
x: The planned subsea connectivity would make Andhra Pradesh India’s third subsea gateway after Mumbai and Chennai.

s: Google's America-India Connect provides a direct fibre path between Visakhapatnam and which city?
x: America-India Connect links Vizag and Chennai on the east coast, supporting the subsea cable landing of the Google Cloud India AI Hub at Visakhapatnam.

s: Which of the following about the Google Cloud India AI Hub in Visakhapatnam is NOT correct?
o: Its water requirement is about 2 million litres per day for every 100 MW.
It does not include an international subsea cable landing.
AdaniConneX and Airtel Nxtra are partners in the project.
It includes a 1 GW hyperscale AI data centre.
x: The hub does include an international subsea cable landing alongside the 1 GW hyperscale AI data centre.

s: Which of the following is NOT correctly stated about the concerns over the Google Cloud India AI Hub?
o: It involves a power demand of about 1 GW.
There was no full EIA or public hearing.
There are concerns of vendor lock-in and data sovereignty.
x: The stated concern is diesel backup, not solar backup; the 1 GW demand, absence of a full EIA/public hearing, vendor lock-in and data sovereignty are listed concerns.

s: The National Quantum Mission, which provides the national framework for quantum technology development, was approved with which of the following outlay and implementation period?
x: The National Quantum Mission was approved in 2023 with an outlay of ₹6,003.65 crore for 2023–24 to 2030–31. The tempting alternative changes the implementation period while retaining the outlay.

s: What is the approximate annual capacity of the ASIP OSAT unit at Tarluvada, Visakhapatnam?
x: The ASIP unit has a capacity of about 96 million chips a year.

s: What is the period of the AP Semiconductor and Display Fab Policy?
x: The AP Semiconductor and Display Fab Policy covers 2024-2029.

s: Which institution is developing India's first Quantum and AI University campus at Amaravati?
x: NIELIT, a deemed university under MeitY, is the developer, with ₹730.70 crore as 100% MeitY grant.

s: Which university set up Andhra Pradesh's first Quantum Incubator at Medha Towers, Gannavaram?
x: Chandigarh University set up AP's first Quantum Incubator for DeepTech start-ups.

s: To what share of the energy mix does the AP State Action Plan on Climate Change 2025–30 aim to raise renewable energy?
x: The plan targets a 40% renewable share, along with one lakh EV charging stations, aligned with SDG 7.

s: Which of the following is NOT among the energy-sector adaptation measures suggested under the AP State Action Plan on Climate Change 2025–30?
o: Efficient drinking-water pumping and lift irrigation
x: The pumping target concerns efficient drinking-water pumping and lift irrigation, not agricultural canal pumping.

s: With reference to the first feeder-level mini solar project connected under PM-KUSUM in Andhra Pradesh, identify the incorrect statement.
o: It has a capacity of 3 MW.
It is located at Nehru Nagar Thanda in Palnadu district.
It provides free daytime power to farmers.
x: The incorrect statement is that the project was connected by NIELIT. The first feeder-level mini solar project was connected by APCPDCL; NIELIT is the developer of the Quantum–AI University. The project has a capacity of 3 MW and supplies free daytime power to farmers.

s: The AP State Action Plan on Climate Change 2025–30 identified the energy sector of which region as the most vulnerable?
x: The energy sector in northern and central Andhra Pradesh was identified as the most vulnerable.

s: What does the AP State Action Plan on Climate Change 2025-30 propose for green hydrogen?
o: Two hubs with a combined 60 MW
Two hubs with a combined 120 GW
Three hubs with a combined 120 MW
x: The plan proposes 2 green hydrogen hubs of a combined 60 MW, along with 120 GW of RE projects.

s: In which year was PM-KUSUM launched?
x: PM-KUSUM was launched in 2019 under MNRE.

s: How many GW of renewable energy projects does the AP State Action Plan on Climate Change 2025-30 aim for?
x: The plan aims at 120 GW of RE projects and a 40% renewable share in the energy mix.

s: Which of the following about Andhra Pradesh at Bharat Tex 2026 is NOT correct?
o: The AP Pavilion was located in Hall No. 9.
It was organised by the Union Ministry of Textiles at Bharat Mandapam, New Delhi.
The Lepakshi handicrafts stall was inaugurated by K. Rekha Rani.
The Apparel Export Promotion Council was to collaborate on export capacity building.
x: The Lepakshi stall was inaugurated by Union Textiles Minister Giriraj Singh; K. Rekha Rani led the Andhra Pradesh MoUs.

s: Where was a sustainable textile recycling facility worth up to ₹4,000 crore proposed at Bharat Tex 2026?
x: The ₹4,000-crore recycling facility is proposed at Visakhapatnam, part of two AP MoUs worth up to ₹4,100 crore.

s: Which South Korean company is the technology partner for Andhra Pradesh’s first OSAT unit?
x: APACT Co. Ltd. of South Korea is the technology partner for the OSAT unit set up with ASIP Technologies.

s: Which of the following Andhra Pradesh–Australia MoU pairs is INCORRECTLY matched?
o: Inclusive education – Teacher capacity for children with autism and neurodiverse needs
Student mental health – Free pilot with virtual counselling and wellness tools
Clean energy – Centre of Excellence for Solar Manufacturing at IIT Tirupati
Skill development – Centre of Excellence for Solar Manufacturing at IIT Tirupati
x: The Solar Manufacturing Centre at IIT Tirupati is the clean energy MoU; skill development covers vocational education, global certifications and international jobs.

s: Which university is responsible for training and expertise at the Centre of Excellence for Solar Manufacturing at IIT Tirupati?
x: UNSW Sydney handles training and expertise in solar cell manufacturing and reliability engineering; the Centre covers solar PV manufacturing and panel recycling.

s: The MoU on medical robotics and intelligent healthcare technologies was signed between which organisations?
o: APTDC and AP State Creativity and Culture Samiti
APEDA and AMTZ Bio Valley Incubation Council
IHFC, IIT Delhi and AIC-AMTZ MediValley, AMTZ
x: The MoU was signed by the Technology Innovation Hub Foundation for IoT and IoE (IHFC), IIT Delhi, and AIC-AMTZ MediValley of AMTZ. Its focus was medical robotics and intelligent healthcare technologies; APTDC and APEDA were not the participating organisations.

s: In the solar Centre of Excellence at IIT Tirupati, which body provides the academic infrastructure, faculty and research?
x: IIT Tirupati provides academic infrastructure, faculty and research; the CoE for Energy Transition handles funding and coordination.

s: Which of the following AMTZ centre–area pairs is correctly matched?
o: Bharat Limb Centre – Rehabilitation and assistive technology
CoE for Additive Manufacturing – MedTech innovation
x: Bharat Limb Centre covers rehabilitation and assistive technology; MediValley is MedTech, Bio Valley is Biotech and the Additive Manufacturing CoE is prototyping.

s: Where was APEX Korea, Andhra Pradesh's first permanent overseas investment facilitation and outreach centre, established?
x: APEX Korea was established in Busan, South Korea.

o: It is located at Rambilli in Anakapalli.
Its Phase 1 is linked with about 3,000 jobs.
Its Phase 1 is linked with about 5,400 jobs.
x: Waaree's Phase 1 is linked with about 3,000 jobs; ₹5,400 crore is the ReNew solar project, not a Waaree job figure.

s: AP Green Energy Corridor Phase-III aims to integrate how much renewable energy?
x: Phase-III targets 18 GW (11 GW solar and 7 GW pumped storage).

s: What is the capacity of the Gandikota-II Pumped Storage Project in YSR Kadapa district?
x: Gandikota-II PSP is of 2,250 MW and was allotted to Adani Hydro Energy Eleven Ltd.

s: India's first Digital Twin Grid is being developed in which State?
x: India's first Digital Twin Grid is being developed in Andhra Pradesh, alongside Green Energy Corridor Phase-III.

s: What is the investment in the Waaree lithium-ion battery (BESS) plant at Rambilli?
x: The Waaree BESS plant costs ₹8,175 crore; ₹5,400 crore is the ReNew solar project at Rambilli.

s: Who is the Union Minister of Power?
x: Manohar Lal Khattar is the Union Power Minister.

s: What is India's national target for non-fossil power capacity by 2030?
x: India aims for 500 GW of non-fossil power capacity by 2030.

s: Which of the following is NOT correct about sand extraction and the Bahuda River?
o: Sand extraction has been reported in the Bahuda near the Andhra Pradesh–Odisha border.
The Sustainable Sand Mining Management Guidelines, 2016 were issued by MoEFCC.
The 2016 guidelines require a District Survey Report.
The Bahuda River is a tributary of the Godavari.
x: The Bahuda is not a tributary of the Godavari. The other statements are correct.

s: Where was the foundation stone of the AM/NS India integrated greenfield steel plant laid on March 23, 2026?
x: The foundation stone was laid at Rajayyapeta in Anakapalli district on March 23, 2026. The other locations are associated with different places or events and are not the foundation-stone site of this plant.

s: What is the production capacity of the first phase of the AM/NS India integrated steel plant at Rajayyapeta?
x: The first phase involves more than ₹70,000 crore, 8.2 million tonnes per year and about 1,00,000 jobs.

s: Beach sand placer deposits on the AP coast form when the Godavari and Krishna carry sediments. What concentrates the heavy minerals?
x: The Godavari and Krishna bring sediments, and waves and tides concentrate the heavy minerals into placers.

s: Andhra Pradesh holds about how much of India's approximately 838 million tonnes of beach sand mineral reserves?
x: Andhra Pradesh has about 211 million tonnes, with the largest reserves of rutile and monazite.

s: Illegal beach sand mining near K. Pallepalem beach in Prakasam district was reportedly undertaken for which purpose?
x: The illegal extraction near K. Pallepalem beach involved heavy machinery and tractors and was undertaken for shrimp hatchery construction. M-sand is presented as an alternative to beach sand mining, not as the purpose of this activity.

s: Which beach sand mineral yields rare earth elements and thorium?
x: Monazite yields rare earths and thorium; ilmenite gives titanium dioxide, rutile is higher-grade titanium ore and garnet an abrasive.

s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: Zircon – refractory furnace linings and kilns
Thorium from monazite – India’s three-stage nuclear programme
Thorium from monazite – refractory furnace linings and kilns
x: Thorium from monazite is linked to the three-stage nuclear programme. Zircon is used in ceramics and nuclear reactors; sillimanite in refractory linings and kilns.

s: Why is the Jonnagiri gold mine (Jonnagiri, Erragudi and Pagidirai, Kurnool district) notable?
o: First lithium-ion battery project after Independence
First gold mining project before Independence
First major public-sector gold mining project after Independence
First major private gold mining project after Independence
x: Jonnagiri is described as India’s first major private gold mining project after Independence. The project covers 598 hectares across Jonnagiri, Erragudi and Pagidirai in Kurnool.

s: Andhra Pradesh has about 25% of India’s beach sand mineral reserves. Which State has a larger share?
x: AP ranks second only to Tamil Nadu in beach sand mineral reserves.

s: Which State became the first to implement an Industry Strategic Partnership under PM-SETU through the Visakhapatnam ITI Cluster?
x: Andhra Pradesh was the first State to implement an Industry Strategic Partnership under PM-SETU through the Visakhapatnam ITI Cluster with ArcelorMittal Nippon Steel India. The other States were not identified for this distinction.

s: What does PM-SETU stand for in the context of the Industry Strategic Partnership involving the Visakhapatnam ITI Cluster?
o: Prime Minister Skilling and Employability Transformation through Upgraded ITIs
Prime Minister Skill Training and Employment Technology through Urban ITIs
Prime Minister’s Scheme for Technical Education and University Training
Prime Minister Skill Expansion and Trade Upgradation
x: PM-SETU stands for Prime Minister Skilling and Employability Transformation through Upgraded ITIs. The other expansions are not the official expansion of the programme.

s: Which of the following statements regarding the legal framework applicable to sand mining is incorrect?
o: The CRZ rules prohibit mechanised beach sand mining.
The MMDR Act places the primary regulation of sand mining with the Centre.
Sand mining is regulated by the States, and Section 15 concerns State rules.
Under the MMDR Act, sand is classified as a minor mineral.
x: The incorrect statement is that the Centre is primarily responsible for regulating sand mining. Sand is a minor mineral regulated by the States, with Section 15 concerning State rules; the CRZ rules also prohibit mechanised beach sand mining.

s: Which of the following is NOT correct about Andhra Pradesh's beach sand minerals?
o: AP has the largest reserves of rutile.
AP has the largest reserves of monazite.
AP has the largest reserves of ilmenite.
AP is second only to Tamil Nadu in total reserves.
x: AP is second-largest, not largest, in ilmenite; it has the largest reserves of rutile and monazite.

s: The AM/NS India steel plant at Rajayyapeta, Anakapalli, is a joint venture of ArcelorMittal and which company?
x: AM/NS India is a JV of ArcelorMittal and Nippon Steel; its stone was laid on 23 March 2026.

s: Who is the developer of the Jonnagiri gold mine in Kurnool district?
x: Geomysore, with Thriveni and Deccan Gold Mines, is developing Jonnagiri, India's first major private gold mine after Independence.

s: Under which mission were critical mineral processing parks approved in Andhra Pradesh, Odisha, Gujarat and Maharashtra in April 2026?
x: The parks (₹500 crore) were approved under the National Critical Mineral Mission (2024) of the Ministry of Mines.

s: Which beach sand mineral is used as an abrasive in sandblasting and waterjet cutting?
x: Garnet is an abrasive; sillimanite is a refractory, zircon is used in ceramics and ilmenite gives titanium dioxide.

s: The Sustainable Sand Mining Management Guidelines, 2016, which made a District Survey Report mandatory, were issued by which Ministry?
o: Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change
x: The SSMMG, 2016 were issued by the MoEFCC and made a District Survey Report mandatory.

s: When was the Coastal Atmospheric Research Testbed (C-ART) at Andhra University, Visakhapatnam, inaugurated?
x: C-ART was inaugurated on 1 May 2026; its sister centres are Bhopal, Mumbai and Mahabaleshwar, with Chennai only planned.

s: What does Phase 1 of the Electric Field Monitor-based Lightning Early Warning Project cover?
x: Phase 1 covers 50 districts in 10 States, including Vizianagaram, Prakasam, Nellore and Anantapur.

s: The Electric Field Monitor-based Lightning Early Warning Project is aligned with which framework that stresses early warning for disasters?
x: The project reflects the Sendai Framework for 2015–2030, which stresses early warning. The remaining options either give the wrong framework or the wrong period.

s: Which of the following statements regarding the Andhra Pradesh Resource Adequacy Regulations–2026 is incorrect?
o: They were introduced for quantum communication and cyber defence.
They were introduced by Andhra Pradesh.
x: The incorrect statement is that the regulations were introduced for quantum communication and cyber defence. The AP Resource Adequacy Regulations–2026 were introduced for renewable-energy integration and long-term power planning. Quantum communication and cyber defence are associated with the Quantum-Secure Communications Test Bed.

s: The first-of-its-kind Quantum-Secure Communications Test Bed in Andhra Pradesh was established at which institution?
x: The first-of-its-kind Quantum-Secure Communications Test Bed was established at SRM University-AP, in collaboration with C-DOT, DoT and Amaravati Quantum Valley. Acharya Nagarjuna University is associated with the NIELIT Innovation & Skilling Centre, while Medha Towers is the starting location of the NSTL centre.

s: The DRDO–NSTL R&D centre in Amaravati Quantum Valley is the second Central institution there after which organisation?
x: NSTL is the second Central institution in Amaravati Quantum Valley, after NIELIT. C-DOT, APSCHE and APSSDC are associated with other quantum or skilling initiatives, but they are not identified as the institution preceding NSTL in the Valley.

s: Andhra Pradesh's deep-tech skilling initiative targets how many learners in 2026–27?
x: The initiative targets 2 lakh learners in 2026–27.

s: Andhra Pradesh's deep-tech skilling initiative aims to train how many learners over five years?
x: The target is 10 lakh learners over five years, with 2 lakh in 2026–27.

s: India’s first indigenous Super Pressure Balloon was launched from which location?
x: India’s first indigenous Super Pressure Balloon was launched from Indira Gandhi Municipal Stadium in Vijayawada. Sri City is associated with the Carrier Global manufacturing unit, not this balloon launch.

s: On which occasion did CM N. Chandrababu Naidu announce the Quantum-Secure Communications Test Bed at SRM University-AP?
o: World Telecommunication and Information Society Day (17 May)
x: It was announced on World Telecommunication and Information Society Day, 17 May; the deep-tech skilling initiative was announced on National Technology Day.

s: Which technology enables secure key sharing in which interception can be detected?
x: Quantum Key Distribution enables secure key sharing in which interception can be detected.

s: The DRDO–NSTL R&D centre in Amaravati Quantum Valley, established at a cost of ₹22.50 crore, is intended to work on which area?
o: Quantum communication hardware and photonic or optical systems only
Quantum computational fluid dynamics and hybrid classical–quantum workflows
Solar ingot-wafer manufacturing and pumped storage
Quantum computing, AI, quantum communication and semiconductors
x: The ₹22.50 crore NSTL centre will focus on quantum computational fluid dynamics and hybrid classical–quantum workflows. Quantum communication hardware and photonic systems are associated with the separate Quantum-Secure Communications Test Bed.

s: Who flagged off India’s first indigenous Super Pressure Balloon launched from Vijayawada?
x: Kinjarapu Ram Mohan Naidu, the Union Civil Aviation Minister, flagged off the balloon. Nara Lokesh was associated with the Sri City foundation event, not this launch.

s: National Technology Day (11 May), on which AP's deep-tech skilling initiative was announced, commemorates the Pokhran tests of which year?
x: National Technology Day marks the Pokhran tests of 1998, not 1999.

s: Near-space, the operational domain relevant to India’s indigenous Super Pressure Balloon, is generally associated with which atmospheric region and altitude range?
x: Near-space lies between aircraft altitude and satellites, with the stratosphere extending approximately from 20 km to 50 km. The other options identify different atmospheric regions or incorrect altitude ranges.

s: Where were the Bharat Quantum Reference Facilities launched in Andhra Pradesh as India's first quantum hardware test beds?
o: SRM University Amaravati and the Punjab and Haryana High Court
SRM University Amaravati and Lok Bhavan, Amaravati
Medha Towers, Vijayawada and Lok Bhavan, Amaravati
SRM University Amaravati and Medha Towers, Vijayawada
x: The Bharat Quantum Reference Facilities, India's first quantum hardware test beds, were launched at SRM University Amaravati and Medha Towers, Vijayawada, on World Quantum Day, 14 April 2026.

s: Which two quantum phenomena are associated with Qubit in the Bharat Quantum Reference Facilities?
x: Qubit uses superposition and entanglement. The other options name phenomena from optics, nuclear science or electricity rather than the two quantum principles specified for Qubit.

s: Where is the NIELIT Innovation & Skilling Centre in Andhra Pradesh located?
x: The NIELIT Innovation & Skilling Centre is at Acharya Nagarjuna University, Guntur.

s: Which start-up developed VISTA SPB-01, India's first indigenous Super Pressure Balloon, launched from Vijayawada?
x: Red Balloon Aerospace built VISTA SPB-01; its maiden mission was Mission SANA (27 May 2026).

s: Which institute set up the Coastal Atmospheric Research Testbed (C-ART), the first observatory of its kind on the Bay of Bengal coast, at Andhra University?
o: Indian National Centre for Ocean Information Services (INCOIS)
x: C-ART at Andhra University, Visakhapatnam, is by IITM; its sister centres are Bhopal, Mumbai and Mahabaleshwar.

s: With which institution did Andhra Pradesh sign an MoU for India's first dedicated Quantum and AI University campus in Amaravati?
x: The NIELIT–AP MoU is for India's first dedicated Quantum and AI University campus in Amaravati.

s: Which of the following is NOT an existing sister centre of the Coastal Atmospheric Research Testbed (C-ART) at Andhra University?
x: C-ART's sister centres are Bhopal, Mumbai and Mahabaleshwar; a Chennai centre is only planned.

s: What is the outlay of the National Quantum Mission (2023–24 to 2030–31)?
x: The National Quantum Mission has an outlay of ₹6,003.65 crore for 2023–24 to 2030–31.

s: Which start-up built the two small indigenous quantum computers at the Bharat Quantum Reference Facilities launched on World Quantum Day 2026?
x: The two small indigenous quantum computers were built by the start-up Qubit Force.

s: What is the name of the maiden mission of VISTA SPB-01, India's first indigenous Super Pressure Balloon?
x: VISTA SPB-01 of Red Balloon Aerospace flew its maiden mission, Mission SANA, from Vijayawada on 27 May 2026.

s: Which of the following AP districts is covered in Phase 1 of the EFM-based Lightning Early Warning Project?
x: Phase 1 covers Vizianagaram, Prakasam, Nellore and Anantapur in AP.

s: South Coast Railway, headquartered at Visakhapatnam, is which railway zone of Indian Railways?
x: South Coast Railway is the 18th zone, not the 17th.

s: Parts of which railway division were merged into the Visakhapatnam division of the South Coast Railway zone?
x: Parts of the Rayagada division (such as Palasa–Ichchapuram and Naupada–Parlakhemundi–Bobbili–Salur) were merged into the Visakhapatnam division. Guntakal, Guntur and Vijayawada are themselves SCoR divisions.

s: Where is the headquarters of South Coast Railway located?
x: Visakhapatnam is the headquarters of South Coast Railway.

s: Which of the following is NOT one of the divisions of South Coast Railway?
x: The four divisions are Visakhapatnam, Vijayawada, Guntur and Guntakal. Rajahmundry is not listed as a division of South Coast Railway.

s: What is the approximate route length of the South Coast Railway zone?
x: SCoR covers 3,532 route km, with works worth ₹54,479 crore; its GM is Sandeep Mathur.

s: The CCEA approved 3rd and 4th railway lines on which section in Andhra Pradesh?
x: 3rd and 4th lines were approved on Ballari–Guntakal (₹1,264 crore); the Kurnool–Ballari line was cleared separately.

s: From which date did the South Coast Railway zone begin operations?
x: After the gazette notification, SCoR (HQ Visakhapatnam) began operations on 1 June 2026.

s: What was introduced for the first time in Andhra Pradesh's irrigation plan for 2026–2028?
o: A target to complete the Polavaram Project in June–July 2027
A 10-year maintenance model for lift irrigation
A Water Calendar specifying water-release dates for deltas and ayacuts
x: A Water Calendar was introduced for the first time, specifying water-release dates for deltas and ayacuts. The 10-year maintenance model, Jaladhara–Jalaharathi movement and the Polavaram target are separate elements of the plan.

s: The 100-day water security programme began at Yadiki village in which district?
x: The programme started at Yadiki village in Anantapur; it is linked to the Jal Shakti Abhiyan of 2019.

s: The Buckingham Canal runs parallel to which coast?
x: The Buckingham Canal runs parallel to the Coromandel Coast through Andhra Pradesh and Tamil Nadu. It is not a Krishna–Narmada link, which is the misleading association in the context of this canal.

s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: Godavari – rises in the Nandi Hills, Karnataka
Penna – meets the Bay of Bengal near Antarvedi
South Coast Railway Zone – headquarters at Vijayawada
Penna – rises in the Nandi Hills, Karnataka
x: The Penna rises in Karnataka’s Nandi Hills and has no large delta. The Godavari meets the sea near Antarvedi, and the South Coast Railway Zone is headquartered at Visakhapatnam.

s: The Polavaram Project is a multipurpose project on which river?
x: Polavaram is a multipurpose project on the Godavari; the drought-prone Rayalaseema project is Handri-Neeva.

s: The Gandhara School of art mainly used which material?
x: Gandhara sculpture used grey schist with Greco-Roman influence, while the Amaravati School used white limestone.

s: The Buddhist site of Nagarjunakonda flourished under the patronage of which dynasty?
x: Nagarjunakonda had Ikshvaku patronage and was linked to Nagarjuna of the Mahayana tradition.

s: Under the Jaladhara–Jalaharathi initiative, which organisation undertakes satellite/GIS mapping of water data?
o: Andhra Pradesh State Handloom Weavers’ Co-operative Society Ltd. (APCO)
Ministry of New and Renewable Energy (MNRE)
x: APSAC undertakes the satellite/GIS mapping for Jaladhara–Jalaharathi, covering water data of 28 districts in 10 days. APCO, MNRE and the Directorate of Animal Husbandry are associated with different subjects in the current-affairs items.

s: How many new projects are included in Andhra Pradesh's irrigation plan for 2026–2028?
x: The plan has 36 projects: 25 pending and 11 new.

s: The 100-day water security programme, which seeks to raise groundwater by at least 1.5 metres, covers how many villages?
x: The programme covers 5,697 villages.

s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Amaravati Blue City project?
o: The city is planned around natural water systems such as reservoirs and canals.
Amaravati is about 14 km from Vijayawada.
Amaravati lies in the Krishna River floodplain.
The Neerukonda Reservoir has a capacity of 0.1 TMC ft.
x: The Neerukonda Reservoir has a capacity of 0.4 TMC ft, not 0.1 TMC ft.

s: Who proposed developing Amaravati as a global creative-economy hub through the Storytelling Corridor at HICSA, Mumbai?
x: AP Tourism Minister Kandula Durgesh made the proposal at HICSA, Mumbai.

s: Amaravati, a node of the Storytelling Corridor with Visakhapatnam and Tirupati, lies on which river?
x: Amaravati is on the Krishna River, not the Godavari.

s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: Krishna – Lam, Pedaparimi and Vykuntapuram reservoirs
Krishna – formed by the Tunga and Bhadra
x: Dowleswaram Barrage is associated with Sir Arthur Cotton. The Krishna is the second-largest east-flowing peninsular river, Tungabhadra is formed by the Tunga and Bhadra, and Lam, Pedaparimi and Vykuntapuram are the planned Amaravati reservoirs.

s: What is the height of the bronze statue of Potti Sriramulu at Smritivan near Tulluru, Amaravati?
x: The statue is 58 feet high, marking his 58-day fast.

s: Potti Sriramulu (‘Amarajeevi’) is remembered for his role in the formation of which State on 1 October 1953?
x: His fast led to the formation of Andhra State on 1 October 1953.

s: What is the target date for completion of the Polavaram Project in AP's irrigation plan for 2026–2028?
x: The Polavaram Project is targeted for June–July 2027; July 2026 is the target for the Polavaram Left Main Canal.

s: By when is Veligonda Project Phase-I targeted for completion?
x: Veligonda Phase-I is targeted for August 2026; Handri-Neeva Phase-II for October 2026.

s: Which is the largest reservoir in the Amaravati Blue City plan?
x: Neerukonda Reservoir (0.4 TMC ft) is the largest; Penumaka is 0.1 and Sakhamuru 0.03 TMC ft.

s: Which drought-prone region does the Handri-Neeva Sujala Sravanthi project, whose Phase-II is targeted for October 2026, serve?
x: Handri-Neeva is a project for drought-prone Rayalaseema; Phase-II is due in October 2026.

s: In AP's irrigation plan, which project, targeted for July 2026, is to carry water to North Andhra?
x: The Polavaram Left Main Canal to North Andhra is targeted for July 2026.

s: Which is the main flood carrier in the Amaravati Blue City plan?
x: Kondaveeti Vagu, rising near Perecharla, is the main flood carrier; a 23.5 km stretch is developed.

s: Who is the Water Resources Minister of Andhra Pradesh?
x: Nimmala Ramanaidu is AP's Water Resources Minister; he leads the 100-day water security programme.

s: Near which place does the Krishna, on which Amaravati lies, rise?
x: The Krishna rises near Mahabaleshwar; the Godavari rises at Trimbakeshwar and the Penna in the Nandi Hills.

s: Which material was mainly used in the Amaravati School of art?
x: The Amaravati School used white limestone; the Gandhara School used grey schist.

s: Near which river is the Buddhist site of Salihundam?
x: Salihundam lies near the Vamsadhara river, not the Krishna.

s: From which region were the new plant species Euphorbia ananthapuramensis, Euphorbia chalamensis and Ceropegia andhrica reported?
x: The three new species were reported from the Eastern Ghats of Andhra Pradesh (E. ananthapuramensis from Nigidi forest, Sri Sathya Sai district).

s: A 14th-century hero stone inscription in Telugu script was found at Vemavaram village in which district?
x: The inscription was found at Vemavaram village, Marripudi mandal, Prakasam district, in Telugu script.

s: What are hero stones called in Tamil?
x: The Tamil term is Nadukal; Veeragallu is the Kannada term.

s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the IVRS survey on ICDS nutrition supply in Andhra Pradesh?
o: 85.2% of beneficiaries received Take Home Ration.
82% were satisfied with nutrition kit quality.
ICDS is delivered through Anganwadi Centres.
x: ICDS is a Centrally Sponsored Scheme (Umbrella ICDS) delivered through Anganwadi Centres, not a State-sponsored scheme.

s: How many services are provided under ICDS?
x: ICDS provides six services: supplementary nutrition, pre-school education, nutrition and health education, immunization, health check-up and referral.

s: On 22 April 2026, within what period did CM Naidu direct that construction of PPP-model medical colleges begin?
x: The CM directed construction of PPP-model medical colleges to begin within one month.

s: Euphorbia ananthapuramensis, one of the newly reported plant species from Andhra Pradesh’s Eastern Ghats, was recorded in which setting?
o: Prakasam district, in coastal sand dunes at 600–700 metres
Madanapalle in Annamayya district, along cultivated agricultural fields at 200–300 metres
Vizianagaram district, in mangrove vegetation at 50–150 metres
Nigidi forest in Sri Sathya Sai district, among granite rocks at 450–550 metres
x: Euphorbia ananthapuramensis was recorded in Nigidi forest of Sri Sathya Sai district, among granite rocks at 450–550 metres. The other options change the location, habitat or elevation.

s:
Consider the following statements about medical colleges in Andhra Pradesh:
1. In September 2025 the State announced 10 new medical colleges under PPP.
2. On 22 April 2026 the CM directed that construction of PPP colleges begin within six months.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
x: 10 PPP medical colleges were announced in September 2025; the April 2026 direction was to begin construction within one month, not six.

s: In the IVRS survey on ICDS nutrition supply in Andhra Pradesh, which district recorded the lowest satisfaction?
x: ASR had the lowest satisfaction (73.3%); Visakhapatnam was the highest (85.6%).

s: What are hero stones called in Kannada?
x: Hero stones are Veeragallu in Kannada and Nadukal in Tamil.

s: ICDS covers children of which age group?
x: ICDS serves children aged 0–6, pregnant women and lactating mothers through Anganwadi Centres.
